# Registry Aggregator v0.4.16

This release integrates Registry Aggregator directly into the native DSH Plugins page and improves Installed/Browse metadata consistency.

## Highlights

- **Native Plugins-page integration** — Registry Aggregator self-embeds below DSH Installed on stock DSH without a manual UI patch.
- **Installed card enrichment** — native Installed cards get update badges and expandable registry metadata while DSH title, enable/disable, and navigation controls remain native.
- **Exact Installed metadata** — installed packages resolve through exact npm lookup with downloads, GitHub stars/repository freshness, bundle verification, tags, and DSH compatibility.
- **Shared card presentation** — Installed details reuse the Browse card presentation but suppress duplicate title, description, install controls, and command text already represented by the native card.
- **Correct star sorting** — missing GitHub star evidence is resolved before server-side Stars sorting and pagination.
- **Consistent popularity UI** — GitHub stars use the same highlighted treatment in Browse and Installed.
- **Runtime compatibility** — DSH compatibility is derived from the active DSH runtime and declared DSH peer dependencies.
- **Persisted Browse state** — query, filters, ordered sort criteria, selected tab, and page size persist across openings.
- **Cache hardening** — metadata/evidence caches are bounded and identical concurrent requests are coalesced.
- **Resilient source behavior** — exact npm package lookup is isolated from unrelated GitHub Search failures.

## Compatibility

- DSH: `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2.0`
- Tested with DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`

## Validation

The release is intended to be published only after the repository CI suite, package dry-run validation, and isolated DSH install smoke test pass.
